notes: «عن عمه أحمد بن عبد الله» is one link whose surface is the name alone (rule 7); «حدثني أبي» is a bare relation

needs ruling (rule 11): the last link tells the story in the first person («قال كان لا يعيش لي ولد») and the Imam al-Rida speaks and acts inside it; whether he is a source or only in the scene is not settled

notes: «دَخَلْتُ عَلَى أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا» narrates an encounter in which the Imam speaks and acts: whether it is a source or only a scene is for ruling (rule 11), so the Imam is not added
